name: iinpublic-nodejs-mobile
description: Embedded node project run by nodejs-mobile on Android/iOS. main.js's require(dist/server/node-app/embedded-node.js) resolves a SINGLE bundled file (scripts/build-embedded-mobile.js, esbuild) with express/socket.io/helmet/cors/bonjour-service/uuid/gun's own server code all inlined — none of those need installing here. 'gun' is the one real runtime dependency below because it's NOT required for that: it's served as-is to the browser/WebView's own Web Worker (public/worker.js's importScripts('/node_modules/gun/gun.js') + '.../sea.js'), a static HTTP file response bundling the server's code can never eliminate. Keep this in sync with the root package.json's gun version.
